title: Traditional German Lamb Kebap
description: A hearty and flavorful lamb kebap dish inspired by German cuisine, featuring robust flavors and tender lamb.

ingredients.name: Turkish Adana Kebap Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets

instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb cubes and Adana Kebap Spice Mix. Mix well to coat.
Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Brush the kebap with olive oil and season with salt.
Grill the kebap for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Serve the kebap with rye bread, sliced fresh cucumber, and red onion.
